name: Undertaking 2
definition: Independent undertaking, such as a demand guarantee or standby letter of credit, that provides financial assurance, to be honoured on the presentation of documents that comply with its terms and conditions.

Beneficiary.name: Beneficiary
Beneficiary.definition: Party in whose favour the counter-undertaking is issued.

ExpiryDetails.name: Expiry Details
ExpiryDetails.definition: Details related to the expiry terms of the counter-undertaking.

CounterUndertakingAmount.name: Counter Undertaking Amount
CounterUndertakingAmount.definition: Details related to the amount of the counter-undertaking.

ConfirmationChargesPayableBy.name: Confirmation Charges Payable By
ConfirmationChargesPayableBy.definition: Indicates whether the applicant/obligor or beneficiary is responsible for payment of the confirmation charges.

GovernanceRulesAndLaw.name: Governance Rules And Law
GovernanceRulesAndLaw.definition: Rules and laws governing the counter-undertaking.

StandardClaimDocumentIndicator.name: Standard Claim Document Indicator
StandardClaimDocumentIndicator.definition: Indication as to whether a claim is to utilise a standard claim form of the issuing institution.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information related to the counter-undertaking.
